info.title: Ryu Box API
info.summary: Persistent isolated workspaces: Boxes, commands, processes, files, previews, terminals, snapshots, secrets and usage.
info.description: Ryu Box runs persistent Linux workspaces whose filesystem survives commands, stop and resume, and forks. Every `/v1` route takes the tenant key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Ryu-hosted Box (`https://box.ryuhq.com`) is early access and enabled per organization by Ryu, which provisions the tenant keys; you can also run the service yourself, where it binds `http://127.0.0.1:8090` by default. Every non-2xx response uses the `BoxError` envelope with `X-Request-ID`; a request whose Accept names `application/problem+json` gets the same error as RFC 9457 problem details (`BoxProblem`). A replayed create or fork answers `200` with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. `429 quota_exceeded` is a quota, not a rate limit: Box sends no `Retry-After` or `RateLimit` fields, and `retryable` says whether waiting can help. The terminal, tunnel and desktop-stream routes are WebSockets, marked `x-ryu-websocket`.

servers.description: Ryu-hosted Box: early access, enabled per organization by Ryu, with Ryu-provisioned tenant keys. It can run an earlier release than this document, so a client should also accept the legacy `box.error` envelope and a replay marked only by type `box.existing`.
A self-hosted Box service at its default local address. The self-hosted service is not yet published.

post.description: Requires an `Idempotency-Key` (at most 128 characters). A repeat with the same key and body returns the first Box with `200`, type `box.existing` and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body gets `409 idempotency_conflict`; and once that Box has been deleted, a repeat gets `409 idempotency_key_resource_deleted` (send a new key to create another Box). With `setup` or `repo` the Box comes back `202` and `provisioning`; poll `GET /v1/boxes/{boxId}` until it is `ready`. An active-Box or resource quota gets `429 quota_exceeded` with `retryable: false` and no `Retry-After`; retrying does not fix it.

get.description: A WebSocket upgrade carrying the Box desktop as raw RFB bytes (binary frames only). It does not take the bearer key: mint a single-use, 30-second token with `POST /v1/boxes/{boxId}/access-tokens` and `scope: desktop`, then offer the `ryu.box.v1` subprotocol and the token's `ryu.token.<token>` subprotocol; a token in the query string is refused with `401 unauthorized`. The page's `Origin` header must be the `origin` the token was minted for (`403 forbidden`). A token works once (`401 token_replayed`), a Box takes at most 4 viewers at a time (`429 quota_exceeded`), and a stream ends after 12 hours. A view-only token drops keyboard and pointer input. A request that is not a WebSocket upgrade gets `426 invalid_request`; `426 not_supported` means the service runs without its Bun server. The organization must have credit (`402 insufficient_credits` on Ryu-hosted Box) before the upgrade.
